stem:
— Could you help me carry this heavy box to the classroom?
— _____.

solution.analysis: 考查回应他人请求的得体表达。对方请求帮助，答语应表示乐意帮忙，My pleasure（我的荣幸/很乐意）是标准回应。A项It doesn't matter用于回应道歉，表示“没关系”；C项Never mind用于安慰对方“别在意”；D项That's right表示赞同，均不符合请求帮助的语境。故选B。

stem:
— Thank you so much for showing me around the school.
— _____.

solution.analysis: 考查回应感谢的得体表达。对方表达感谢，回答应用It's my pleasure / You're welcome（不客气，这是我的荣幸）。A项Don't say that不符合英语交际习惯；B项No, thanks用于婉拒对方提供的东西；D项That's too bad表示遗憾，与感谢语境无关。故选C。

stem:
— I'm sorry I forgot to bring your book back. I'll return it tomorrow.
— _____. Take your time.

solution.analysis: 考查回应道歉的得体表达。对方道歉并说明补救措施，答语应表示谅解，No problem（没关系）最合适，后句Take your time（不急）也印证了宽容态度。B项You're welcome用于回应感谢；C项I think so表示“我认为是这样”；D项Go ahead用于允许对方做某事，均不合语境。故选A。

stem:
— Would you like to join us for the school picnic this Saturday?
— _____. I have to visit my grandparents.
options: B. I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't.

solution.analysis: 考查回应邀请的得体表达。面对邀请，如果无法接受，应先表示感谢并礼貌拒绝，I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't是标准句式，后句说明原因（要去看望祖父母）。A项与后句矛盾；C项It doesn't matter用于回应道歉或无关紧要的事；D项Of course not过于生硬无礼。故选B。

stem:
— I've been feeling tired these days. What should I do?
— _____.
options: A. Why don't you get more sleep?
B. I'm sorry to hear that.

solution.analysis: 考查对征求意见的应答。对方问What should I do（我该怎么办），这是在请求建议，答语应给出具体建议，Why don't you...?（为什么不……呢？）是提建议的常用句型。B项只是表示同情，没有回答问题；C项It's up to you表示“由你决定”，用于回应选择问题；D项That's a good idea用于评价对方提出的建议，此处对方并未提建议。故选A。

stem:
— Could I use your pen for a moment? Mine doesn't work.
— _____. Here you are.

solution.analysis: 考查回应借用请求的得体表达。对方请求借用钢笔，后句Here you are（给你）表明说话人同意出借，因此前面应表示允许，Sure, go ahead（当然可以）最合适。B项Not at all用于回应感谢或mind类问句；C项Never mind用于安慰对方；D项You're welcome用于回应感谢。故选A。

stem:
— I've just won the first prize in the English speech contest!
— _____. I'm so proud of you.

solution.analysis: 考查对好消息的祝贺表达。对方获奖后告知好消息，答语应表示祝贺，Congratulations（恭喜）是标准用语，后句I'm so proud of you（我真为你骄傲）进一步印证喜悦之情。B项Good luck用于祝愿对方将来好运，多用于事前；C项Best wishes用于送别或节日祝福；D项Take it easy用于让对方放松，均不符合祝贺语境。故选A。

stem:
— Do you mind if I close the window?
— _____. It's really cold outside.

solution.analysis: 考查Do you mind...?句型的应答，为易错陷阱题。对方问“你介意我关窗吗”，后句说明外面很冷，说明说话人不介意对方关窗，应回答Not at all（一点也不介意）或Of course not。A项Yes, I do表示“我介意”，与后句逻辑矛盾；C项Never mind用于安慰对方“别担心”；D项It doesn't matter用于回应道歉。故选B。

stem:
— Would you like something to drink, sir?
— _____. Two cups of coffee, please.
options: A. Yes, I'd like some coffee.

solution.analysis: 考查餐厅点餐场景的应答。服务员问“您想喝点什么”，客人应直接说出需求，Yes, I'd like some coffee（是的，我想要咖啡）与后句Two cups of coffee, please一致。B项Help yourself（请自便）用于招待客人用餐；C项I'm full now（我吃饱了）回应的是关于是否再吃的询问；D项It's up to you表示“由你决定”，不用于点单。故选A。

stem:
— Can I help you?
— _____. I'm looking for a pair of sports shoes.

solution.analysis: 考查购物场景中店员问候语的应答。Can I help you?是店员招呼顾客的常用语，顾客如有需要应回答Yes, please（是的，请），后句说明想买运动鞋。B项No, thanks表示不需要帮助，与后句相矛盾；C项You're welcome用于回应感谢；D项Not at all用于回应感谢或mind类问句。故选A。

stem:
— What's the matter with you? You look pale.
— _____.

solution.analysis: 考查就医场景中描述病情的应答。对方问What's the matter with you（你怎么了）并观察到你脸色苍白，应回答具体不适，I've got a headache（我头疼）符合语境。B项I'm a doctor（我是医生）答非所问；C项Nothing much, thanks多用于回答“最近怎么样”；D项I'm feeling better now（我现在好些了）与前句You look pale矛盾。故选A。

stem:
— Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the railway station?
— _____. Go straight and turn left at the second crossing.
options: B. Sure, it's not far from here.

solution.analysis: 考查问路场景的应答。对方询问去火车站的路，答语应先表示愿意帮忙并给出路线信息，Sure, it's not far from here（当然，离这儿不远）与后句指路内容衔接自然。A项It's my pleasure用于回应感谢；C项That's all right用于回应道歉；D项You can't miss it（你一定能找到）是指路结束时的补充语，不能作为开头应答。故选B。

stem:
— Hello! May I speak to Mr. Wang?
— _____.

solution.analysis: 考查电话用语。接电话时向对方表明自己的身份，应用This is Wang speaking（我是小王）或Speaking，这是电话交际的固定表达，不能使用I'm Wang。A项Who are you?（你是谁）语气生硬且不是电话用语；B项I'm Wang不符合电话习惯；D项Are you Wang?是反问，不合逻辑。故选C。

stem:
— May I ask a question, Mr. Li?
— _____. What is it?

solution.analysis: 考查课堂场景中请求许可的应答。学生问“我可以问个问题吗”，老师应表示允许并让提问，Of course, go ahead（当然，请讲）最得体，后句What is it?（什么问题？）与之呼应。B项No, you may not（不可以）过于生硬，不符合师生交际；C项It's my turn表示“轮到我了”，答非所问；D项That's right用于赞同对方观点。故选A。

stem:
— Would you mind if I joined your volunteer group this weekend?
— _____. The more, the merrier.

solution.analysis: 考查Would you mind if...?句型的应答。对方问“你介意我这个周末加入你们的志愿者小组吗”，后句The more, the merrier（人越多越热闹）表明说话人欢迎对方加入，应回答Not at all（一点也不介意）。B项Yes, please用于接受对方提供的东西，不能回应mind类问句；C项Thank you用于感谢；D项Good luck用于祝愿好运，与欢迎加入的语境不符。故选A。

stem:
The new library at Sunshine Middle School is very popular. It opens at 8:00 a.m. and closes at 6:30 p.m. on weekdays, but on weekends it only opens from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Students can borrow up to five books at a time and must return them within two weeks. The library has a quiet reading room on the first floor and a computer room on the second floor. Many students go there after class to do homework or read magazines. Mrs. Chen, the librarian, says the library is now the busiest place in the school.

第1题：When does the library close on weekdays?

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文第一句It opens at 8:00 a.m. and closes at 6:30 p.m. on weekdays可知，工作日图书馆下午6:30闭馆。A项8:00 a.m.是开馆时间；B项4:00 p.m.是周末闭馆时间；D项9:00 a.m.是周末开馆时间。定位原文关键词closes和weekdays即可得出答案C。

stem:
Our school has many clubs for students. The English Club meets every Tuesday afternoon and helps students practise speaking. The Science Club meets on Thursday and does interesting experiments. The Basketball Club trains on Monday and Friday, and the Art Club meets on Wednesday to draw and paint. Students can join two clubs at most. This term, the Science Club is the most popular, with over sixty members. Everyone is welcome, so just come and find something you enjoy!

第1题：Which club meets on Thursday?

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文The Science Club meets on Thursday and does interesting experiments可知，科学俱乐部周四活动。A项English Club是周二；B项Basketball Club是周一和周五；C项Art Club是周三。只要在原文中逐一核对各俱乐部活动时间，即可选出答案D。

stem:
Last Friday, our school held its annual sports day. The weather was fine and the playground was full of cheering students. Li Hua ran in the 800-metre race and won first place. Wang Fang jumped 1.55 metres in the high jump and broke the school record. The relay race was the most exciting part, and Class 3 finally won it. In the afternoon, teachers and students played a friendly basketball match. Everyone agreed that it was a wonderful day full of fun and teamwork.

第1题：What did Li Hua win in the sports day?

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文Li Hua ran in the 800-metre race and won first place可知，李华在800米赛跑中获得第一名。A项跳高获奖的是王芳；C项接力赛获胜的是三班；D项篮球赛是师生友谊赛，未提到获胜者。抓住人名Li Hua在原文中定位，即可得出答案B。

stem:
Do you want to study better? Here are some useful tips. First, make a study plan and stick to it. Second, review your notes every evening before going to bed, because the brain keeps working while you sleep. Third, ask your teachers questions in class if you don't understand something. Finally, take a short break every forty-five minutes when you study at home. Remember, studying is like planting a tree: you must be patient and keep watering it every day.

第1题：What does the writer suggest doing every evening?

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文Second, review your notes every evening before going to bed可知，作者建议每天晚上复习笔记。A项制定计划是第一步建议，未说明每晚进行；B项在课堂上问老师问题是第三条建议；C项每学习四十五分钟休息一下是第四条建议，与“每晚”无关。根据关键词every evening定位，答案D。

stem:
Sunshine High School has made a new rule about smartphones. From this term, students may not use their phones in class or during exams. If a student is seen using a phone in class, the teacher will keep the phone until the end of the day. However, students can still use their phones in the dining hall and in the dormitory after 9:30 p.m. The rule was made because many students were distracted by games and messages during lessons. Most parents support the rule, saying it helps their children focus on study.

第1题：What is the new rule about smartphones?
options: A. Students can use phones anywhere.
B. Students can't use phones in class or during exams.
C. Phones are not allowed in the dining hall.
D. Phones must be kept at home.

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文students may not use their phones in class or during exams可知，新规定是学生在课堂上和考试期间不得使用手机。A项与规定相反；C项原文说学生可以在食堂使用手机；D项原文说学生9:30后可在宿舍使用手机，并未要求把手机留在家中。锁定关键词new rule，答案B。

stem:
A new cleaning robot has started working in our school dining hall. The robot, named Xiaoqing, is about one metre tall. It can sweep the floor, collect dirty trays and even say “Excuse me” politely when it passes students. Xiaoqing works from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. and from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. every day. The robot is powered by electricity and can work for eight hours after one charge. Students think it is cool, and the dining hall is now much cleaner.

第1题：What can the robot Xiaoqing do?
options: B. Sweep the floor and collect trays.

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文It can sweep the floor, collect dirty trays and even say “Excuse me”可知，机器人能扫地、收餐盘并礼貌地说“借过”。A项做饭未提及；C项教英语未提及；D项原文说机器人充电后可工作八小时，说明它需要充电，该项表述错误。根据can后列举的动作定位，答案B。

stem:
In Guangdong, drinking tea is part of everyday life. People drink tea at home, in offices and in restaurants. When guests come to visit, the host always serves tea first before talking about anything else. Young people are taught to pour tea for elders first and to tap the table with two fingers to say “thank you” when someone pours tea for them. There are many kinds of tea, such as green tea, black tea and oolong tea. For local people, a day without tea is like a day without sunshine.

第1题：What do hosts do when guests come to visit?
options: D. They cook a big meal.

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文When guests come to visit, the host always serves tea first可知，客人来访时主人总是先上茶。A项唱歌、C项关门、D项做大餐在文中均未提及。根据关键词guests和host定位第一处茶文化描写，答案B。

stem:
The Dragon Boat Festival falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. On this day, people eat zongzi, a kind of rice dumpling wrapped in bamboo leaves, and watch dragon boat races on rivers. The festival is held to remember Qu Yuan, a great poet who lived over two thousand years ago. In many cities, dragon boat teams train for months before the race. Some schools also teach students how to make zongzi, so that the tradition can be passed down from generation to generation.

第1题：When is the Dragon Boat Festival celebrated?
options: A. On the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.
B. On the first day of the first lunar month.
C. On the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month.
D. On the ninth day of the ninth lunar month.

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文第一句The Dragon Boat Festival falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month可知，端午节在农历五月初五。B项是春节（正月初一）；C项是中秋节（八月十五）；D项是重阳节（九月初九）。本题只需定位第一句的时间表达，答案A。

stem:
A recent study shows that many teenagers do not get enough sleep. Scientists say that teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep every night to grow well and learn well. However, many students stay up late doing homework or playing with phones. As a result, they feel tired in class and cannot concentrate. Dr. Li, a health expert, suggests that students go to bed before 10:30 p.m. and keep their phones outside the bedroom. “A good night's sleep is the best medicine for study,” she says.

第1题：How many hours of sleep do teenagers need every night according to scientists?

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep every night可知，科学家认为青少年每晚需要8到10小时睡眠。A、B、D项的数字均与原文不符。题干中according to scientists是定位关键，对应原文Scientists say that...，答案C。

stem:
Exercise is important for everyone. Jogging for thirty minutes a day can make your heart stronger, help you sleep better and reduce stress. You don't need expensive equipment; a pair of good shoes is enough. If you find jogging boring, you can try swimming, cycling or playing ball games with friends. The key is to exercise regularly. Doctors advise teenagers to do at least one hour of physical activity every day. Remember, a healthy body is the foundation of a happy life.

第1题：What benefit of jogging is mentioned in the passage?
options: A. It makes the heart stronger.
C. It makes food taste better.

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文Jogging for thirty minutes a day can make your heart stronger, help you sleep better and reduce stress可知，慢跑能增强心脏功能、改善睡眠、减轻压力，A项是其中之一。B、C、D项在文中均无依据。根据题干benefit和jogging定位第一句的列举，答案A。

stem:
To reduce plastic waste, our school has taken action. Last year, the school stopped selling bottled water in the shops and put up drinking fountains in every building. Students are encouraged to bring their own water bottles and reusable lunch boxes. The school also collects used bottles and sends them to a recycling centre. In just one year, the amount of plastic waste on campus dropped by half. The Green Club students made posters to remind everyone: “Less plastic, better planet.”

第1题：What did the school do to reduce plastic waste?
options: A. It sold more bottled water.
B. It stopped selling bottled water.
C. It threw all plastic bottles away.
D. It closed the school shops.

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文the school stopped selling bottled water in the shops and put up drinking fountains可知，学校停止销售瓶装水并安装直饮水机。A项与原文相反；C项“扔掉所有塑料瓶”文中未提及；D项“关闭学校商店”不准确，商店仍在但不再卖瓶装水。根据reduce plastic waste定位行动内容，答案B。

stem:
On Tree-Planting Day, students from Grade 7 planted two hundred trees behind the playground. With the help of their teachers, they dug holes, put the young trees in and watered them. Each class wrote its name on a small board and placed it beside the trees. The students promised to look after the trees, and they will visit them every month. In a few years, the playground will be surrounded by green shade, and the school will be a more beautiful place to study.

第1题：How many trees did the students plant?

solution.analysis: 细节理解题。由原文第一句students from Grade 7 planted two hundred trees可知，学生们共种了200棵树。其余选项的数字与原文不符。本题为直接数字细节题，抓住关键词two hundred即可选出答案B，无需理解全文。

stem:
Sara used to be slow at running and often finished last in PE class. One day, her teacher told her that practice could make a difference. So Sara began to run every morning before school. Soon her classmates noticed her progress and asked to run with her. Now more than fifty students run together every morning, and the group is called the Morning Star Running Club. Sara is proud that she not only became faster herself, but also helped others fall in love with running.

第1题：What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. How Sara became a better runner and started a club.
B. How to win a running race at school.
C. Why running is bad for students.
D. How the PE teacher taught Sara to swim.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。全文按照时间顺序讲述了Sara从跑步落后到坚持晨跑、带动同学、最终成立跑步俱乐部的成长故事。A项“Sara如何成为更好的跑者并创办俱乐部”完整概括了主旨。B项“如何赢得赛跑”范围过窄且文中未写比赛；C项与文章积极态度相反；D项“教游泳”与内容无关。综合首尾句可确定答案A。

stem:
Music is more than just a way to have fun. Fast music can make us feel excited and full of energy, while slow, soft music can calm us down when we are nervous. Many students listen to light music while studying, and they find it easier to focus. Scientists also say that learning to play an instrument trains the brain and improves memory. No matter what kind of music you like, it can bring colour to your life.

第1题：What is the main idea of the passage?
options: A. Music can affect our feelings and bring benefits.
B. Fast music is better than slow music.
C. Everyone should learn to play an instrument.
D. Music is only for fun.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。文章从“音乐影响情绪”（兴奋或平静）、帮助集中注意力、训练大脑改善记忆等方面说明音乐的作用，A项“音乐能影响我们的情绪并带来好处”概括全面。B项“快歌比慢歌好”是错误比较，文中无此观点；C项“每个人都应学乐器”过于绝对；D项与全文主旨相悖。把握主题句Music is more than just a way to have fun，答案A。

stem:
Many students think museums are boring places full of old things. But in fact, museums are like time machines. They tell us stories about the past, from ancient coins to modern inventions. They also help us understand different cultures and the way people lived. Some museums even let visitors touch and try things, which makes learning fun. A visit to a museum is not a waste of time; it is a wonderful journey of discovery.

第1题：What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. The value and fun of visiting museums.
B. The history of ancient coins.
C. How to build a museum.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。文章先提出“很多学生认为博物馆无聊”的观点，再用But转折，指出博物馆如时间机器、能了解历史与文化、甚至可以动手体验，最后总结“参观博物馆是奇妙的发现之旅”。A项“参观博物馆的价值与乐趣”准确概括主旨。B项“古钱币历史”只是例证；C项“如何建博物馆”未提及；D项“为什么学生讨厌博物馆”只对应开头铺垫。注意转折词But后的内容才是主旨所在，答案A。

stem:
Long ago, before planes and trains, traders travelled across deserts and mountains to exchange goods. They carried Chinese silk, tea and paper to the West along a road that later became known as the Silk Road. In return, they brought back grapes, glass and new ideas. The Silk Road was not only a trade road; it was also a bridge between different cultures. Its story tells us that people have always wanted to connect with each other.

第1题：What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. The Silk Road and what it meant to people.
B. How to make Chinese silk.
D. The food people ate long ago.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。文章围绕丝绸之路展开：商人运送丝绸、茶叶、纸张，带回葡萄、玻璃和新思想，说明它既是贸易之路也是文化桥梁。A项“丝绸之路及其对人们的意义”概括了主要内容。B项“如何制作丝绸”未提及；C项“现代飞机火车”只是开头的对比引入；D项“古人吃的食物”范围过窄。抓住关键词Silk Road，答案A。

stem:
Reading is like opening a window to a wider world. When you read, you can travel to faraway places without leaving your chair, and meet people from different times. Reading also improves your language skills, because you learn new words and sentence patterns naturally. Besides, readers usually think more clearly, because stories train them to follow ideas step by step. That is why teachers always say: the more you read, the more you grow.

第1题：What is the main idea of the passage?
options: A. Reading brings knowledge and trains thinking.
B. Reading is only useful for exams.
C. People should read in their chairs only.
D. Reading makes people leave home.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。文章用“阅读像打开一扇窗”作比喻，从了解远方世界、提高语言能力、训练思维三个方面说明阅读的好处，结尾the more you read, the more you grow点明主旨。A项“阅读带来知识并训练思维”概括准确。B项“只为考试”以偏概全；C项是字面误解；D项与原文“不出家门即可旅行”相反。答案A。

stem:
At home, my family separates waste into three bins: one for kitchen waste, one for recyclables and one for other waste. Every weekend, my father takes the recyclable bottles and paper to the recycling station. My mother makes sure the kitchen waste goes to the right bin. At first it was hard to remember, but now it has become a habit. We are happy because we are doing something small but useful for the earth.

第1题：What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. How the family sorts waste at home.
B. How to cook with kitchen waste.
C. Why the family moves to a new house.
D. How to make bottles at home.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。文章描述了“我”家如何在家中进行垃圾分类：三个垃圾桶、爸爸送可回收物、妈妈处理厨余垃圾。A项“一家人如何在家分类垃圾”概括了全文内容。B项“用厨余垃圾做饭”、C项“搬家”、D项“在家制作瓶子”均与文章无关。抓住关键词waste、bins、recycling即可确定主旨，答案A。

stem:
Scientists have found that students who sleep well remember their lessons better. During sleep, the brain goes through what we learned during the day, sorts out the important information and stores it in long-term memory. That is why students who stay up late to study often forget more the next morning. So before a big exam, the best thing you can do is not to read more books, but to have a good sleep.

第1题：What is the main idea of the passage?
options: A. Good sleep helps students remember what they learn.
B. Students should stay up late to study.
C. Exams are more important than sleep.
D. The brain stops working during sleep.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。文章说明科学家发现睡眠好的人记得更牢，解释大脑在睡眠中整理、储存信息，并建议考前好好睡觉。A项“好的睡眠帮助学生记住所学内容”是全文主旨。B项与原文建议相反；C项无依据；D项“大脑在睡眠时停止工作”与原文“大脑在睡眠中整理信息”矛盾。注意转折与结论句The best thing you can do is...，答案A。

stem:
Last summer, I worked as a volunteer at the city library for two weeks. My job was to help readers find books and put returned books back on the shelves. At first, I was nervous because I didn't know where everything was. But the librarians were kind, and the readers were patient with me. By the end of the two weeks, I could find any book in minutes. More importantly, I learned to be helpful and responsible. Volunteering not only helped others, but also helped me grow.

第1题：What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. The writer's experience of volunteering at a library.
B. How to write a book.
C. The history of the city library.
D. How to become a librarian.

solution.analysis: 主旨大意题。文章按时间顺序讲述“我”在图书馆做两周志愿者的经历：从紧张到熟练，最终学到乐于助人和有责任心。A项“作者在图书馆做志愿者的经历”准确概括主旨。B项“如何写书”、C项“图书馆历史”、D项“如何成为图书管理员”均与内容无关。文章以第一人称叙述经历，答案A。

stem:
China's new spaceship, which can carry more astronauts and stay in space for a longer time, passed its latest test last month. Engineers say the spaceship was designed for future missions to the moon station. They are now building more training centres for young astronauts. According to the plan, the first moon mission may happen within ten years. Students who are interested in space are encouraged to study science and maths hard, because the space programme needs more young talent.

第1题：What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. China will never send astronauts to the moon.
B. The new spaceship will probably be used for moon missions.
C. Students don't need to study science for space work.
D. The spaceship can carry fewer astronauts than before.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文the spaceship was designed for future missions to the moon station以及the first moon mission may happen within ten years可推断，新飞船很可能用于未来的登月任务。A项与计划中的登月任务矛盾；C项与原文鼓励学科学数学相反；D项原文说能搭载更多宇航员，与之相反。根据designed for future missions推断，答案B。

stem:
Researchers put cameras in a forest to watch pandas in the wild. The videos show that pandas spend about fourteen hours a day eating bamboo. They only move when they are hungry or need to find a new bamboo forest. Scientists were surprised that pandas rarely play or explore, unlike other animals of the same size. From the videos, they also learned that pandas meet each other mainly during the mating season.

第1题：What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. Pandas like to play and explore all day.
B. Pandas eat bamboo only when they are hungry.
C. Pandas are not very active animals.
D. Pandas live together in large groups.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文pandas spend about fourteen hours a day eating bamboo和pandas rarely play or explore可推断，熊猫大部分时间都在吃竹子、很少活动，是行动不活跃的动物。A项与rarely play or explore矛盾；B项原文说它们一天吃十四小时竹子，且“饿了才移动”，并非饿了才吃；D项“成群生活”原文未提及，且文中提到它们主要在繁殖季节相见。综合归纳，答案C。

stem:
Bike-sharing has become very popular in big cities because it is cheap and good for the environment. Every day, thousands of people ride shared bikes to work or school. However, some users leave the bikes anywhere, blocking the roads and sidewalks. City workers have to spend hours collecting the bikes every day. The government is now setting up more parking stations and asking users to park bikes in the right places.

第1题：What does the writer think of bike-sharing?
options: A. It is useless and should be stopped.
B. It is convenient but has some problems.
C. It is only good for the government.
D. It has no effect on the environment.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。文章先说共享单车便宜又环保（优点），再用However转折指出乱停放、堵路的问题（缺点），最后说政府正采取措施。作者用however连接前后内容，态度客观，可推断他认为共享单车方便但存在问题。A项“无用应停用”过于极端；C项“只对政府有利”无依据；D项与“对环境好”相反。抓住转折词However前后的对比，答案B。

stem:
Our dog Max always waits by the door at exactly five o'clock, the time I get home from school. When he hears my footsteps on the stairs, he starts wagging his tail. The moment I open the door, he jumps up to greet me and brings me his favourite toy. Even on rainy days when I am late, he is still there, sitting patiently. My mother says Max has an inner clock and knows the time better than we do.

第1题：What can we infer about Max?
options: B. Max is very loyal and loves the writer.
C. Max can tell people the exact time.
D. Max never plays with toys.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。从Max每天准点在门口等待、听到脚步摇尾巴、递玩具迎接等细节可推断，它忠诚且深爱主人。A项“讨厌雨天”无依据，文中说雨天它仍耐心等待；C项“能报时”是对“inner clock”比喻的误解；D项与“brings me his favourite toy”矛盾。综合细节描写推断作者与狗的感情，答案B。

stem:
The new subway Line 3 will connect the city centre with the airport. Workers are now testing the trains and checking the stations day and night. The line has twelve stations in total, and the whole journey will take only thirty-five minutes. The city government says the line will open to the public next spring. Many people who often travel by air are looking forward to it, because taking a taxi to the airport is expensive and slow.

第1题：What will probably happen soon?
options: A. The subway line will be open to the public.
B. The subway line will be closed forever.
C. Taxis will stop running in the city.
D. The airport will move to the city centre.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文Workers are now testing the trains以及the line will open to the public next spring可推断，地铁3号线即将（明年春天）开通运营。B项“永远关闭”与即将开通相反；C项“出租车停运”无依据，原文只说打车贵又慢；D项“机场搬迁”文中未提。根据测试和开通计划的时间线索推断，答案A。

stem:
Mr. Chen, who is seventy years old, still makes paper umbrellas by hand in his small workshop. It takes him three days to finish one umbrella, because every step, from cutting the paper to painting the pictures, must be done carefully. Few young people are willing to learn this craft, as it is hard and pays little. Mr. Chen worries that the skill may die with him. He hopes more people will see the value of traditional handcrafts.

第1题：What can we infer from the passage?
options: A. Paper umbrellas are easy to make quickly.
B. The traditional craft may disappear in the future.
C. Young people are very interested in making umbrellas.
D. Mr. Chen makes money easily from his umbrellas.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文Few young people are willing to learn this craft以及the skill may die with him可推断，这门传统手艺可能失传。A项与“做一把伞要三天、步骤精细”矛盾；C项与“几乎没有年轻人愿学”相反；D项与“pays little（挣钱少）”矛盾。根据Mr. Chen的担忧和年轻人不愿学的现状综合推断，答案B。

stem:
Too much homework and frequent exams make some students feel stressed. Experts say that stress is not always bad; a little pressure can push us to work harder. But when stress lasts too long, it can hurt our health and sleep. Experts suggest that students talk to their parents or friends about their feelings, do sports regularly and take short breaks during study. “Opening your heart is the first step to feeling better,” one expert says.

第1题：The writer would most probably agree that ________.
options: A. students should never feel any pressure
B. talking about feelings helps reduce stress
C. doing more homework can solve stress
D. stress is always harmful to students

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文Experts suggest that students talk to their parents or friends about their feelings以及Opening your heart is the first step to feeling better可推断，作者赞同“倾诉有助于缓解压力”。A项“学生不该有任何压力”与原文“一点压力能推动我们更努力”矛盾；C项“多做作业缓解压力”与文意相反；D项“压力总是有害”与“stress is not always bad”矛盾。根据专家建议推断作者态度，答案B。

stem:
The Internet brings us a world of information, but not all of it is true. Some news on social media is made up or exaggerated just to get more clicks. If we believe everything we read online, we may make wrong decisions. That is why teachers now spend time teaching students how to check the source of information and compare different reports. Being able to tell the truth from lies is an important skill in the information age.

第1题：What can we learn from the passage?
options: A. All information on the Internet is true.
B. We should check the source before believing online news.
C. Social media never spreads false news.
D. Making wrong decisions is unavoidable.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。文章指出网上有些信息是编造或夸大的，并说老师教学生“check the source of information and compare different reports”，由此可知我们应该核实信息来源后再相信。A项与“not all of it is true”矛盾；C项与“Some news on social media is made up”相反；D项“犯错误不可避免”过于绝对且无依据。综合原文建议推断，答案B。

stem:
Shawan, an old town near Guangzhou, keeps its narrow streets, grey brick houses and ancient temples. Unlike modern cities full of tall buildings, the town looks almost the same as it did a hundred years ago. Every weekend, thousands of visitors come to walk along the old streets, taste the local snacks and take photos. The town government has promised to protect the old buildings while developing tourism carefully.

第1题：What can we infer about Shawan?
options: A. It is a newly built modern town.
B. It is popular with visitors and well protected.
C. It has no traditional buildings left.
D. Visitors never go there on weekends.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文thousands of visitors come every weekend和The town government has promised to protect the old buildings可推断，沙湾古镇受游客欢迎且得到良好保护。A项与“looks almost the same as it did a hundred years ago”矛盾；C项与“keeps its narrow streets, grey brick houses”矛盾；D项与“every weekend visitors come”相反。综合游客量与保护承诺，答案B。

stem:
Every autumn, thousands of birds stop at the wetland park on their long journey south. They rest, feed on small fish and insects, and store energy for the flight ahead. The park, which was once a fish farm, has become an important stopping place for more than a hundred kinds of birds. Workers keep the water clean and plant reeds to protect the birds. Birdwatchers come from all over the country to watch them.

第1题：Why do the birds stop at the wetland park?
options: A. To find a warmer place to live forever.
B. To rest and feed before continuing their journey.
D. To escape from other birds.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文They rest, feed on small fish and insects, and store energy for the flight ahead可推断，候鸟在此停留是为了休息、觅食、储存能量，然后继续南飞。A项“永远住下来”与“long journey south”矛盾；C项“看观鸟者”颠倒了主客关系；D项“躲避其他鸟类”文中未提。根据rest、feed、store energy三个动词推断目的，答案B。

stem:
At the end of the film, the hero finally found his family after ten years of searching. The cinema became completely silent, and then many people in the audience wiped their eyes. Some were even moved to tears. When the lights came on, everyone stood up and clapped for a long time. The director, who was sitting in the back row, stood up and bowed to the audience with a big smile.

第1题：How did the audience feel at the end of the film?

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。由原文many people wiped their eyes、moved to tears、everyone stood up and clapped可推断，观众被影片打动并感到激动，用掌声表达赞赏。A项“生气无聊”与现场反应相反；C项“困倦”无依据；D项“紧张担心”不符合结局时观众的表现。根据wipe eyes、tears、clap等细节推断情绪，答案B。

stem:
When I moved to a new school last term, I felt lonely and missed my old friends. On the first day, Tom, my deskmate, noticed that I ate lunch alone. He invited me to sit with him and his friends. Later, he taught me how to play basketball and took me to the school library. Now I have many good friends, and I look forward to going to school every day. I will never forget Tom's kindness.

第1题：What does the writer value most according to the passage?
options: D. Moving to a new school.

solution.analysis: 推理判断题。文章讲述Tom在“我”孤独时主动邀请、帮助“我”融入新学校，结尾I will never forget Tom's kindness点明作者最珍视的是友谊与善意。A项“打篮球”只是Tom带作者做的事；B项“图书馆”只是地点；D项“转学”本身并非作者珍视的对象，转学带来的是孤独。综合全文情感走向，答案C。

stem:
In our science class, students showed the small gadgets they had made at home. One gadget could water plants automatically when the soil was dry. Another could open the door by voice, and a third could remind people to drink water every hour. Although these gadgets were simple, they were full of creativity. Our teacher said that every great invention starts with a small idea, and encouraged us to keep exploring.

第1题：The underlined word “gadgets” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。由上下文可知，学生们展示的是能自动浇水、声控开门、提醒喝水等小型发明装置，且后文说它们simple but full of creativity，可推断gadget意为“小装置、小发明”。B项“大机器”与simple矛盾；C项“玩具”不符合功能描述；D项“工具书”是工具书dictionary等的意思。结合功能举例与修饰语simple，答案A。

stem:
After months of hard work in the school vegetable garden, we finally harvested our first tomatoes and cucumbers. The joy of harvest was beyond words. We had watered the plants, pulled out the weeds and protected them from insects. Now we understood why farmers are so proud of their fields. Our teacher smiled and said, “In study, you harvest what you plant. Work hard, and you will enjoy a rich harvest in the future.”

第1题：The underlined word “harvest” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。第一处harvest作动词，与“first tomatoes and cucumbers”搭配，指经过数月劳作“收获”果实；第二处名词the joy of harvest指收获的喜悦。A项“播种”是plant/sow，与“after months of hard work”不符；C项“出售”文中未提及；D项“品尝”只是收成后可能的动作。结合耕作过程与结尾比喻，答案B。

stem:
To sustain the balance of nature, we must protect wetlands, forests and oceans. Wetlands clean the water and give animals a home. Forests take in carbon dioxide and produce fresh air. Oceans provide food for billions of people. If we continue to pollute and cut down trees, many species will disappear and the balance will be broken. Protecting the environment is protecting ourselves. Everyone should do his or her part.

第1题：The underlined word “sustain” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。由下文对湿地、森林、海洋作用的介绍（净化水质、提供氧气和食物）以及“如果继续污染砍伐，平衡将被打破”可知，sustain the balance意为“维持生态平衡”。B项“破坏”与保护生态的目的相反；C项“改变”程度不符；D项“观察”与语境无关。根据“若破坏则会打破平衡”的对照关系，答案A。

stem:
Morning exercise can boost your energy for the whole day. After jogging for twenty minutes, you will feel more active and think more clearly in class. Many students who exercise in the morning say they no longer feel sleepy before lunch. Doctors also say that a short run can improve your mood, so you will face the day's challenges with a smile. Why not try it tomorrow morning?

第1题：The underlined word “boost” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。由后文“跑完二十分钟后，你在课堂上更活跃、思维更清晰”可知，晨练能“提升”一整天的精力。B项“减少”与效果相反；C项“消耗”虽可用于精力，但句意应是增强而非消耗；D项“浪费”不合逻辑。根据后文feel more active的具体效果推断词义，答案A。

stem:
A smart watch can track your heart rate, sleeping time and steps every day. It collects your health data and shows them clearly on the screen. If your sleep is not enough, the watch will remind you to rest. Doctors can also use the data to learn about your health condition. Thanks to such devices, people can take better care of themselves. However, experts warn that we should not depend on machines too much.

第1题：The underlined word “track” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。由后文“它收集你的健康数据并清晰显示在屏幕上”可知，智能手表的功能是“追踪记录”心率、睡眠和步数。B项“控制”程度过重，手表不能控制身体数据；C项“治疗”是医生的职责；D项“忘记”与记录功能相反。根据collects your health data的同义复现推断，答案A。

stem:
In the morning, I always grab a piece of bread and run to the bus stop, because I get up too late. As a result, I often feel hungry before lunch. My mother says this is a bad habit and asks me to get up earlier. She prepares a rich breakfast for me every day, but I never have enough time to enjoy it. This weekend, I plan to set my alarm clock ten minutes earlier.

第1题：The underlined word “grab” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。由后文run to the bus stop、get up too late可知，“我”起床太晚，只能“匆忙拿起”一片面包赶公交。B项“慢慢品尝”与赶时间的语境矛盾；C项“仔细检查”不合逻辑；D项“小心放下”与“带去吃”不符。根据赶车的紧张情境推断词义，答案A。

stem:
Graduation day was bittersweet for our class. We were excited to move on to senior high school, but sad to say goodbye to our teachers and friends. We took photos in front of the school gate, wrote messages in each other's notebooks and promised to keep in touch. Some girls cried when the headmaster made his speech. In the end, we all agreed that the three years of junior high were the sweetest time of our life.

第1题：The underlined word “bittersweet” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。由后文解释we were excited to move on, but sad to say goodbye可知，毕业这天既高兴又难过，即“苦乐参半”。B项“平淡无奇”与情感描写不符；C项“令人失望”只含负面；D项“轻松愉快”只含正面，均未涵盖“既开心又不舍”的双重情感。根据but前后的对比解释推断词义，答案A。

stem:
New energy buses are now running in many cities. They are better for the environment because they don't burn petrol and produce little noise. The buses have USB ports under the seats, so passengers can charge their phones during the ride. They also use a special system to show how many people are on the bus. Thanks to these buses, the city air is getting cleaner, and more people choose to travel by bus.

第1题：The underlined word “charge” in the passage means ________.

solution.analysis: 词义猜测题。由原文passengers can charge their phones during the ride和USB ports（USB接口）可知，乘客可以坐在座位上用USB接口给手机“充电”。B项“收费”是charge的另一词义，但USB接口与收费无关；C项“指控”为法律义项；D项“换乘”是transfer。根据USB ports这一线索词确定词义，答案A。

stem: Taking good notes in class is an important study skill. [1]. It can help you remember the key points and prepare for exams. First, listen carefully and think about what the teacher says. [2]. If you try to write down every word, you may miss the main ideas. Second, use short forms and symbols to write faster. [3]. Third, review your notes after class on the same day. [4]. Finally, keep your notebooks tidy and use different colours for different parts. [5]. With good notes, your study will become more efficient and enjoyable.
options: A. However, you should only write down the most important points.
B. In addition, writing down the questions you don't understand is also helpful.
C. Good notes are like a map that guides you through your lessons.
D. This will help you remember the information better.
E. In this way, you can find the information you need quickly.

solution.analysis:

solution.analysis:
范文：Should Students Take Phones to School?
In my opinion, students should not take phones to school. Firstly, phones make us distracted in class. Some students play games or send messages instead of listening to the teacher, which is bad for their studies. Secondly, looking at screens for a long time hurts our eyes and health. Besides, comparing phones with others may cause unnecessary problems. To solve this, our school can set up lockers for phones at the school gate. If students need to contact their parents, they can use the office phone. Let's put our hearts into study and grow up healthily.

范文：An Unforgettable Volunteer Experience

stem: The word "brilliant" in the sentence "She gave a brilliant speech at the meeting" means ________.

solution.analysis: 考查brilliant的词义。brilliant本义为“明亮的、闪耀的”，引申为“杰出的、精彩的”，brilliant speech指“精彩的演讲”，故A正确。B项“乏味的”是boring；C项“简短的”是short/brief；D项“响亮的”是loud。结合语境a brilliant speech（精彩的演讲）即可判断，答案A。

stem: Choose the best word to complete the sentence: The teacher asked us to ________ our answers before handing in the papers.

solution.analysis: 考查动词词义辨析。交卷前应先“检查”答案，check意为“检查、核对”，符合语境。B项cheer“欢呼”与语境无关；C项change“改变”句意不通；D项charge“收费、充电”为干扰项（与check形近）。四个选项形近词辨析，结合before handing in（交卷前）的语境，答案A。

stem: The word "prevent" in "Washing hands often can prevent diseases" means ________.

solution.analysis: 考查prevent的词义。prevent意为“预防、阻止”，prevent diseases即“预防疾病”，符合勤洗手的作用，故A正确。B项“治疗”是cure/treat；C项“传播”是spread；D项“减轻”是reduce。根据生活常识“勤洗手能预防疾病”，答案A。

stem: The word "abandon" in "They had to abandon the plan because of the sudden storm" means ________.

solution.analysis: 考查abandon的词义。abandon意为“放弃、抛弃”，because of the sudden storm（由于突如其来的暴风雨）说明被迫“放弃”计划，故A正确。B项“坚持”是stick to/insist on，与被迫放弃的逻辑相反；C项“修改”是revise；D项“讨论”是discuss。根据因果逻辑（风暴→放弃计划），答案A。

stem: Which word can best replace "delighted" in "The children were delighted to see the first snow of winter"?

solution.analysis: 考查delighted的同义替换。delighted意为“高兴的、欣喜的”，孩子们看到初雪应是“开心的”，故用happy替换，答案B。A项angry“生气的”、C项tired“疲惫的”、D项worried“担心的”都与看到初雪的喜悦情绪相悖。根据语境情感色彩判断，答案B。

stem: We should ________ water, because fresh water is becoming less and less.

solution.analysis: 考查语境选词。后文说“淡水越来越少”，因此我们应当“节约”水，save意为“节约、节省”，答案A。B项spend“花费”；C项waste“浪费”与节约的呼吁相反；D项collect“收集”虽可搭配水，但与“越来越少”的逻辑不如save贴切。根据因果逻辑判断，答案A。

stem: The school library is a good place for students to ________ books and study quietly.

solution.analysis: 考查语境选词。在图书馆里可以“借”书并安静学习，borrow意为“借入”，答案A。B项cook“做饭”、C项paint“画画”、D项climb“攀爬”都与图书馆的功能不符。根据地点library的典型行为判断，答案A。

stem: The school meeting was ________ because the headmaster was ill and could not attend.

solution.analysis: 考查语境选词。校长生病无法出席，会议因此被“取消”，cancelled意为“取消”，答案A。B项celebrated“庆祝”与会议语境不符；C项attended“出席”是被动语态“被出席”，逻辑不通；D项organised“组织”与because从句无因果关系。根据“生病→取消会议”的因果关系判断，答案A。

stem: After ten years, she still ________ her old friend the moment she saw him at the airport.

solution.analysis: 考查语境选词。十年未见，但在机场看到老朋友的那一刻她“认出”了他，recognized意为“认出”，答案A。B项refused“拒绝”；C项repeated“重复”；D项remained“保持、留下”，均与“见到老友”的语境不符。the moment she saw him（她一看到他）强调瞬间认出，答案A。

stem: The doctor advised him to ________ smoking, or his health would get worse and worse.

solution.analysis: 考查动词短语辨析。医生建议他“戒掉”吸烟，否则健康会恶化，give up smoking“戒烟”，答案A。B项put up“张贴、举起”；C项turn up“出现、调大”；D项look up“查阅、抬头看”，均不能与smoking构成合理搭配。根据“否则健康恶化”的警告逻辑判断，答案A。

stem: In the sentence "He is a warm person, always ready to help others", the word "warm" means ________.

solution.analysis: 考查熟词生义。warm常见义为“温暖的”，但此处修饰人，与always ready to help others（总是乐于助人）相呼应，意为“热情的、热心的”，答案A。B项“温暖的”是warm的常见义，但修饰人的性格时应用引申义；C项“凉爽的”是cool；D项“冷淡的”是cold。根据后文解释判断，答案A。

stem: In the sentence "The meeting will run for two hours", the word "run" means ________.

solution.analysis: 考查熟词生义。run常见义为“跑”，但此处与for two hours（两个小时）搭配，意为“持续”，即“会议将持续两个小时”，答案A。B项“奔跑”是常见义，但会议不能奔跑；C项“经营”是run的另一义项（run a company），不适用于会议；D项“流动”用于run water等。根据for two hours时间段判断，答案A。

stem: In the sentence "The plan met with a cold reception from the students", the word "cold" means ________.

solution.analysis: 考查熟词生义。cold常见义为“寒冷的”，但此处修饰reception（对待、反应），a cold reception意为“冷淡的对待”，即学生们对这个计划不感兴趣，答案A。B项“寒冷的”是常见义，但reception指态度而非天气；C项“潮湿的”是wet；D项“温暖的”是warm。结合reception的搭配和句意判断，答案A。
